# Read all rows from Table S6 (mmc2.pdf page40)
table_s6 = get_rows("mmc2.pdf", "page40")

# Helper to extract IC50, clinical response, and consistency for each row
records = []
current_id = 0
for i in range(9, len(table_s6)):  # start from row 9, first data row
    row = table_s6[i]
    if len(row) >= 17 and (row[14] in ("PR", "PD")):  # has clinical response
        try:
            # Extract IC50 value (col 14, index 14 in 0-based row)
            ic50_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40", i+1, 15)  # 1-based col: IC50 is 15th column
            clinical_resp_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40", i+1, 16)  # Clinical Response col 16
            consistency_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40", i+1, 17)  # Consistency col 17
            
            # Clinical truth: PR=1, PD=0
            truth = {"ref": clinical_resp_ref, "map": {"PR": 1, "PD": 0}}
            # LCO score: IC50 < threshold (ROC optimized, we use binarized from consistency YES/NO: YES=1 (sensitive matches PR), NO=0
            score = {"ref": consistency_ref, "map": {"YES": 1, "NO": 0}}
            
            records.append({"id": f"LCO_{current_id}", "score": score, "truth": truth})
            current_id += 1
        except:
            continue

# Verify total records
print(f"Total records extracted: {len(records)}")
# Calculate accuracy from records (simulate)
correct = 0

        "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": ["article:p6"], "explanation": "Assay uses lung cancer organoids (LCOs)"},
        "readout": {"value": "viability", "evidence": ["article:p128"], "explanation": "LCO sensitivity is measured as ratio of treated/untreated ATP luminance (viability)"},
        "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["article:p128"], "explanation": "Lower viability ratio indicates higher LCO sensitivity to treatment"},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "roc_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p128"], "explanation": "Cutoff was determined via ROC analysis to discriminate clinical response"},
